**[Creation] Forest Keepers: The Minds of Ebos**

[Appearing as trees](https://i.sli.mg/2SmBGQ.jpg), [The Keepers](https://i.sli.mg/xRMlsV.jpg) will develop deep and far reaching root systems. These sentient, yet immobile beings connect with each other through the roots of the plant-life on Ebos, and they are telepathic. Immortal for as long as there is life on Ebos, they remember much of what has happened around them, including what has happened to others connected to the root system. Their telepathy allows them to collect the thoughts and feelings of those around them, building knowledge and stories of the world, and acting as a living database with information ranging from individual's unique life stories, to technical advancements, and deep dark secrets. Proximity matters; the farther from The Keepers and their forests, the less likely they'll be privy to information. A civilization benefiting from, living in or near one of their forests will have few secrets from The Keepers. Some races may find this useful, others may find it invasive.

Although they do share a type of hive-mind, all having access to the collected information, individual Keepers have their own unique personalities and may choose to share or not share their information. As an example, a Keeper in the Golden Forest would be straightforward and friendly (to the right persons); a Keeper in the Rose Forest would probably be vague and overly dramatic; a Keeper in the Forest of Wrangled Trees is grumpy and withholding, or perhaps event obstinate or abusive. Because they are telepathic, they often know why they're being questioned (but not always).

Lawful-Neutral, they will follow their own rules and prefer not to give out knowledge which may lead to evil deeds, however, they can be convinced, tricked and deceived. Their judgement is not infallible.
